# kafka-sre-ops-toolkit
> Python SRE toolkit for Apache Kafka / MSK: lag monitors, rebalance helpers, topic capacity planning, incident runbooks.

Part of **Boryslav Deputat** public engineering portfolio (Austin, TX). Built with KLAV (UA AI) / КЛАВ (УКР ШІ).
